A '''clonetroller''' was a piece of equipment owned by the [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]], who was the assistant to [[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]], the [[Prime Minister (Kamino)|Prime Minister]] of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
